body:
## Approved Implementation Plan

### Sub-Task 1: Timeframe Filtering Module (Standard)
- Create `acs/src/server/timeframe.rs` with TimeframeQuery, resolve_date_range, filter_daily_buckets, aggregate_buckets
- CostSummary structs matching ticket response format
- Explicit cross-model token aggregation (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens → total_cache_read_tokens)
- Files: `server/timeframe.rs` (new), `server/mod.rs`
- Deps: None

### Sub-Task 2: Per-Job Cost Summary Endpoint (Standard)
- `GET /api/jobs/{id}/cost-summary` handler
- Uses list_runs() for runs_by_status breakdown
- Owns route registration for all 3 new endpoints
- Files: `server/routes.rs`, `server/mod.rs`
- Deps: Sub-Task 1

### Sub-Task 3: Global Cost Summary Endpoint (Standard)
- `GET /api/costs/summary` handler
- Aggregates across all jobs, computes today_usd/week_usd/month_usd, today_tokens, top_jobs
- Files: `server/routes.rs`, `server/mod.rs`, `server/timeframe.rs`
- Deps: Sub-Tasks 1, 2

### Sub-Task 4: Raw Manifest Endpoint (Light)
- `GET /api/jobs/{id}/manifest` handler
- Files: `server/routes.rs`
- Deps: None (parallel with Sub-Task 1)

### Sub-Task 5: Enhance Test Doubles (Light)
- Update InMemoryLogStore in BOTH server/mod.rs and tests/api_tests.rs
- Files: `server/mod.rs`, `tests/api_tests.rs`
- Deps: None (parallel with Sub-Tasks 1, 4)

### Sub-Task 6: Unit Tests (Standard)
- 12+ tests including empty/zero data edge cases
- Files: `server/mod.rs`
- Deps: Sub-Tasks 1-5

### Sub-Task 7: Integration Tests (Standard)
- 6+ tests including empty/zero data edge cases
- Files: `tests/api_tests.rs`
- Deps: Sub-Tasks 1-5

### Parallelization
- Wave 1: Sub-Tasks 1, 4, 5 (parallel)
- Wave 2: Sub-Tasks 2, 3 (after 1)
- Wave 3: Sub-Tasks 6, 7 (after all)
